comments.content: Good to hear that @whilefoo. If this is the case, the issue 1. should still be solved.

### Describe the background or context
I spent over three hours trying to verify my PR and get 'QA' and I stumbled against a serious bug.
There are two problems: 
1. Inserting or modifying any database row with type defined as a fixed length char is currently broken and allows only 1 character. I verified this with supabase dashboard. The root cause is https://github.com/PostgREST/postgrest/issues/2861 which was fixed but the fix is not available yet in the workspace.
2. Error handling is supabase adapter is broken and it must be fixed e.g.
https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquibot/blob/development/src/adapters/supabase/helpers/client.ts#L165
https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquibot/blob/development/src/adapters/supabase/helpers/client.ts#L170
https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquibot/blob/development/src/adapters/supabase/helpers/client.ts#L178
https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquibot/blob/development/src/adapters/supabase/helpers/client.ts#L193
Modifying db entries return data or error, but nothing is done when error happens. The functions happily return with just logger traces and the bot claims that everything went well, see https://github.com/gitcoindev/ubiquibot/issues/6#issuecomment-1678456596 and bot comments below. Only when I locally modified the source to insert "1" as wallet address, it was truly successful.
### Describe the solution
1. Use variable char in DB, even for address and validate variables length where needed:
https://github.com/PostgREST/postgrest/issues/1586#issuecomment-696821113
2. Implement a proper error handling in supabase adapter.
@whilefoo good job! Just minor typos in log output `Upserting a access` -> `Upserting access` but the error handling logic looks fine. I leave to internal team to QA and approve.
